title: Duplicate product IDs across stores
searchText: duplicate product ids across stores issue nyohayon-jpg/apollo-data-importer last night's import overwrote products because `product_id` is only unique **within** a store. store 3 and store 7 both have product_id 10452 (different items). fix: key products by `(store_id, product_id)` instead of `product_id` alone. reported by priya shah. open nyohayon-jpg bug backend 6253625595 nyohayon-jpg priya shah: confirmed with a sample from store 3 and store 7 – 214 product ids collide. pr coming. 2026-10-18t18:37:25z 2026-10-18t18:36:51z 2026-10-18t18:37:25z

data.body:
Last night's import overwrote products because `product_id` is only unique **within** a store. Store 3 and Store 7 both have product_id 10452 (different items).

Fix: key products by `(store_id, product_id)` instead of `product_id` alone.

Reported by Priya Shah.
